summaries.summary: A Class 12 student's death in Delhi, found burnt behind a school guard room, has sparked investigations into a possible suicide, with police discovering notes related to the incident.
Apple's iPhone Duo is being rolled out to stores amid limited supply and repair guides, while startups are advised on customer acquisition strategies without going viral.
OpenAI has decided to halt training its AI models on live internet data due to significant risks, while various companies explore improvements and fixes for their devices.
Tensions escalate in the Middle East, with Iran's intelligence chief warning of increased attempts to target US personnel, coinciding with Trump’s military threat alerts.
Delhi High Court dealt with Neha Bora's peace bond case, with her challenging the validity of the notice based on diary entries leading to curbs on dissent.
Tiger Shroff faced backlash after praising Salman Khan, which triggered a controversial attack, highlighting tensions in the Bollywood industry.
Mumbai police arrested a man linked to terrorist activities, highlighting ongoing concerns over national security.
A daylight murder caught on CCTV in Maharashtra has shocked the public, prompting widespread media coverage on the incident.
